claims.claim: University of Sydney researchers estimate the Milky Way's central bar extends approximately 4.3 kiloparsecs from the galactic center.
claims.episode_span: Researchers estimate the bar extends approximately 4.3 kiloparsecs, about 14,000 light-years, from the galactic center along its long axis.
claims.source_title: Galactic shock: Discovery challenges our understanding of the Milky Way's structure
claims.supporting_quote: The researchers estimate the bar extends approximately 4.3 kiloparsecs—about 14,000 light-years—from the galactic center along its long axis, supporting a relatively long, slowly rotating structure.

claims.claim: The Mercury Imaging X-ray Spectrometer observed the Crab Nebula for 39 hours across 55 spacecraft slews on Sept. 11–12.
claims.episode_span: The main observation sequence consisted of 55 spacecraft slews with 39 hours of observations during Sept. 11–12.
claims.source_title: Mercury-bound X-ray telescope delivers first images after eight years in space
claims.supporting_quote: The main observation sequence consisted of 55 spacecraft slews, with 39 hours of observations during Sept. 11–12.

claims.claim: SSC Space's optical stations in Australia and Chile each offer up to 10 gigabits per second.
claims.episode_span: SSC Space's stations in Australia and Chile each offer up to 10 gigabits per second.
claims.source_title: NTT and SSC Space Explore a Global Laser Network for Satellite Data
claims.supporting_quote: SSC Space's stations in Australia and Chile offer up to 10 gigabits per second each.

claims.claim: Around 300 students from secondary schools across Whitehorse gathered on November 18 to hear CSA astronaut Jenni Gibbons.
claims.episode_span: Around 300 students from secondary schools across Whitehorse gathered on November 18 to hear CSA astronaut Jenni Gibbons discuss space exploration and Canada's role in Artemis II and the Crew-13 mission.
claims.source_title: From Whitehorse to space: Yukon students hear from CSA astronauts Jenni Gibbons and Joshua Kutryk
claims.supporting_quote: On November 18, around 300 students from secondary schools across Whitehorse and community members gathered to hear CSA astronaut Jenni Gibbons talk about space exploration and Canada's role in Artemis II and the Crew-13 mission.

claims.claim: Astronomers detected velocity variations of about 10 miles per second around the red dwarf TYC 3980-1081-1.
claims.episode_span: Velocity variations of about 10 miles per second prompted follow-up observations with the Gemini North telescope that directly detected the faint white-dwarf companion.
claims.source_title: A rare triple-star system has been detected by astronomers
claims.supporting_quote: Indeed, they observed changes in its velocity of about 10 miles per second (16 kilometers per second).
